Vallinayagam, TANGEDCO Shri Aashish Anand Bernard, Advocate, PTC Order in I.A. No. 58/2019 in Petition No. 255/MP/2017 Page 1 # ** ORDER ** The Petitioner, Adhunik Power and Natural Resources Limited, has filed the present Interlocutory Application (IA) to modify the order dated 30.4.2019 in Petition No. 255/MP/2017 and to grant carrying cost to the Petitioner on the change in law claims allowed by the Commission. 2. During the course of hearing, learned counsel for West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited submitted that in the main Petition, the Petitioner had not prayed for grant of carrying cost. Therefore, the present IA is not maintainable. 3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present IA with liberty to the Petitioner to file miscellaneous Petition for grant of carrying cost. 4. The prayer of the Petitioner is allowed. Accordingly, IA No. 58/2019 is disposed of as withdrawn. Sd/sd/sd/- **(I.S.Jha) (Dr. M.K. Iyer) (P.K. Pujari) Member Member Chairperson** Order in I.A.
